---
title: IDL Notes
description: IDL sources, hand-written vs auto-generated, and usage.
---

## Two IDL sources

bake has two independent, both-valid IDL sources:

### Auto-generated

Location: `anchor/target/idl/recipe_book.json`

Produced by `anchor build`. This is the standard Anchor workflow.

### Hand-written

Location: `src/idl/recipe_book.json`

Written and live-validated against the deployed program when auto-generation was temporarily broken during development.

## Which one to use

Both are proven correct via live on-chain calls. The hand-written one is currently used by `RealRecipeBookClient` because:
- It's the durable fallback if toolchain issues break auto-generation
- It was validated with real `initialize_recipe_book` + `register_deploy` calls

## Do not delete either

> **Warning:** Do not delete the hand-written IDL — it's the fallback if auto-generation breaks again. If you switch to the auto-generated one, validate it the same rigorous way first.

## IDL structure

```json
{
  "address": "56Vj61zFW4hHV6wdjnisrHtVwWDqyjixjpBgnoRJvzxL",
  "metadata": {
    "name": "recipe_book",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "spec": "0.1.0"
  },
  "instructions": [...],
  "accounts": [...],
  "errors": [...],
  "types": [...]
}
```

## Dashboard IDL

The dashboard (`bakeacookie`) has its own copy at `lib/idl/recipe_book.json` — also hand-verified. If the on-chain program changes, update this by copying from the CLI repo (the CLI repo is the source of truth).

## Anchor build flags

```bash
anchor build --arch v0 --tools-version v1.57
```

- `--arch v0` — targets older, compatible instruction set (required for local validator)
- `--tools-version v1.57` — pins platform-tools version for reproducibility

`--no-idl` is **no longer needed** — IDL auto-generation works correctly with the above flags.
